name: Warsaw
notes: Warsaw city+metro powiats; Siedlce subregion; Skierniewice/Rawa and Tomaszow/Opoczno from Lodzkie

name: Lodz
notes: Lodzkie minus Skierniewice and Tomaszow areas; plus Konin subregion of Wielkopolskie

name: Plock
notes: Plock + Ciechanow + Ostroleka subregions of Mazowieckie; Wloclawek (K-P); Dzialdowo (W-M)

name: Krakow
notes: Malopolskie + Podkarpackie + Bielsko subregion + Sosnowiec/Dabrowa/Jaworzno/Zawiercie + Zamosc subregion

name: Katowice
notes: Central Upper Silesian conurbation + Czestochowa subregion; Silesian autonomists have no recognised tag

name: Opole
notes: Opolskie + Gliwice and Rybnik subregions of Slaskie

name: Lower Silesia
notes: Dolnoslaskie + Leszno/Rawicz (Wlkp) + southern Lubuskie (Zielona Gora/Zary/Zagan/Nowa Sol)

name: Lubusz
notes: Northern Lubuskie (Gorzow subregion) + Mysliborz/Choszczno; Oder-Neisse line = west edge

name: Poznan
notes: Wielkopolskie minus Konin/Leszno/Rawicz/Zlotow; German claims dropped (1990 treaty)

name: Gdansk
notes: Gdansk + Sopot + Gdansk/Nowy Dwor powiats; DNZ core removed

name: Kuyavia-Pomerania
notes: Kujawsko-Pomorskie minus Wloclawek + Gdynia/Kashubia/Kociewie (Pomorskie) + Ilawa; KSH core removed

name: Zaolzie
notes: Karvina district + eastern Frydek-Mistek (Trinec/Cesky Tesin/Jablunkov); Czech since 1945

name: Czech Silesia
notes: Ostrava + Opava + Bruntal + western Frydek-Mistek + Jesenik + Sumperk districts

name: Moravia
notes: South Moravia minus Znojmo + Zlin + Olomouc (minus Jesenik/Sumperk) + Novy Jicin + Vysocina (Jihlava/Zdar/Trebic) + Svitavy

name: Western Slovakia
notes: Bratislava + Trencin kraje; Trnava minus Dunajska Streda; northern Nitra; Zilina minus Orava/Liptov; Banska Bystrica/Zvolen area

name: Eastern Slovakia
notes: Presov kraj + Orava + Liptov + Brezno + Michalovce/Sobrance/Spis (Kosice kraj north)

name: Vilnius
notes: Vilnius city+district; Trakai; Salcininkai; Svencionys; Varena; Ignalina

name: Aukstaitija
notes: Panevezys county + Utena county (minus Ignalina) + Pakruojis/Joniskis

name: Samogitia
notes: Siauliai county remainder + Telsiai + Taurage + rural Klaipeda county

name: Riga
notes: Riga city + Riga district + Jurmala + Ogre

name: Virumaa
notes: Ida-Viru + Laane-Viru + Jarva + Jogeva; Narva river border (Ivangorod Russian)

name: Tartu
notes: Tartu + Voru + Polva + Valga; Petseri (Pechory) is Russian - province too coarse to split

name: Brest
notes: Brest oblast minus Baranovichi area; Kamin-Kashyrskyi/Liubeshiv/Zarichne provinces moved to Ukraine

name: Grodno
notes: Grodno oblast minus Ashmyany/Smarhon/Astravets + Baranovichi area (Brest) + Stowbtsy

name: Molodechno
notes: NW Minsk oblast (Maladzyechna/Vileyka/Myadzel/Valozhyn) + west Vitebsk oblast (Pastavy/Braslaw/Hlybokaye) + NE Grodno oblast

name: Bobruisk
notes: Babruysk area (Mogilev oblast) + southern Minsk oblast (Salihorsk/Slutsk/Nesvizh)

name: Minsk
notes: Minsk city + central Minsk oblast + Mogilev city and districts

name: Gomel
notes: Gomel city + eastern Gomel oblast + eastern Mogilev oblast (Krychaw/Horki/Kastsyukovichy)

name: Vyborg
notes: Vyborg + Priozersk districts (Len. obl.) + Sortavala/Lahdenpokhya/Pitkyaranta/Suojarvi (Karelia); Russian since 1944

name: Murmansk
notes: Murmansk oblast minus Pechenga and Alakurtti

name: Petrozavodsk
notes: Southern Karelia republic (Petrozavodsk/Kondopoga/Olonets) + Lodeynoye Pole/Podporozhye (Len. obl.)

name: Tikhvin
notes: Tikhvin/Boksitogorsk (Len.) + Borovichi/Pestovo (Novgorod) + west Vologda + north Tver

name: Pskov
notes: Pskov city + NW Pskov oblast incl. Pechory; gains Pytalovo province from Latgale

name: Velikiye Luki
notes: Southern Pskov oblast (Velikiye Luki/Nevel/Sebezh) + west Tver + Velizh

name: Smolensk
notes: Smolensk oblast minus Roslavl south and north districts

name: Vologda
notes: Vologda oblast minus west/Vytegra + northern Kostroma oblast (Sharya/Manturovo/Galich)

name: Lviv
notes: Lviv city + northern Lviv oblast + Ternopil oblast

name: Volhynia
notes: Volyn + Rivne oblasts (incl. provinces gained from Polesie)

name: Cherkasy
notes: Cherkasy oblast + most of Kirovohrad oblast + Haisyn area

name: Svealand
notes: Stockholm + Uppsala + Sodermanland + Vastmanland + Orebro counties
